'''Sourav Chatterjee''' {{postnominals|FRS}} (born 26 November 1979)<ref>[http://www.stat.berkeley.edu/~sourav/aboutme2.html "About Me"] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100613133215/http://www.stat.berkeley.edu/~sourav/aboutme2.html |date=13 June 2010 }}, Sourav Chatterjee homepage at the University of California at Berkeley.</ref> is an Indian [[mathematician]] from West Bengal, specialising in [[mathematical statistics]] and [[probability theory]]. Chatterjee is credited with work on the study of fluctuations in random structures, concentration and super-concentration inequalities, Poisson and other non-normal limits, first-passage percolation, [[Stein's method]] and [[spin glasses]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://imstat.org/2008/03/04/2008-tweedie-award/|title = Institute of Mathematical Statistics &#124; 2008 Tweedie Award}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.infosys-science-foundation.com/prize/laureates/2020/sourav-chatterjee.asp|title = Infosys Prize - Laureates 2020 - Prof. Sourav Chatterjee}}</ref> He has received a [[Sloan Fellowship]] in mathematics, Tweedie Award,<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://imstat.org/ims-awards/ims-awards-recipients/|title = Institute of Mathematical Statistics &#124; IMS Awards Recipients}}</ref> [[Rollo Davidson Prize]], [[Doeblin Prize]], [[Loève Prize]], and [[Infosys Prize]] in mathematical sciences. He was an invited speaker at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] in 2014.

==Career==
Chatterjee received a Bachelor and Master of Statistics from [[Indian Statistical Institute]], Kolkata, and a [[Ph.D.]] from [[Stanford University]] in 2005, where he worked under the supervision of [[Persi Diaconis]].<ref>*{{MathGenealogy|id=93637}}
</ref> Chatterjee joined [[University of California, Berkeley]], as a visiting assistant professor, then received a tenure-track assistant professor position in 2006. In July 2009 he became an [[associate professor]] of statistics and mathematics at University of California, Berkeley. Then in September 2009, Chatterjee became an associate professor of mathematics at the [[Courant Institute of Mathematical Sciences]], [[New York University]].<ref name=cvberkeley>[http://www.stat.berkeley.edu/%7Esourav/cv_sourav.pdf CV at Berkeley] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130925231135/http://www.stat.berkeley.edu/%7Esourav/cv_sourav.pdf |date=25 September 2013 }}</ref> He spent the academic year 2012–2013 as a visiting associate professor of mathematics and statistics at [[Stanford University]]. Since autumn 2013 he has joined the faculty of Stanford University as a full professor with joint appointments in the departments of Mathematics and Statistics.<ref name=aboutmestanford>[http://www-stat.stanford.edu/~souravc/aboutme.html "About me"], Sourav Chatterjee homepage at Stanford University.</ref>

He has served as an associate editor of ''Annals of Probability'', ''Annales de l'[[Institut Henri Poincaré]]'' (B) ''Probabilities et Statistiques'', "Probability Theory and Related Fields". He currently serves as an editor of ''Communications in Mathematical Physics''.<ref name=Homepage>{{cite web | url=https://profiles.stanford.edu/sourav-chatterjee | title=Sourav Chatterjee's Profile &#124; Stanford Profiles }}</ref>

==Awards and honours==
*2008 Tweedie New Researcher Award, from the Institute of Mathematical Statistics.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://imstat.org/ims-awards/ims-awards-recipients/|title = Institute of Mathematical Statistics &#124; IMS Awards Recipients}}</ref>
*Sloan Research Fellowship in Mathematics, 2007–2009{{citation needed|date=October 2022}}
*[[Rollo Davidson Prize]] 2010{{citation needed|date=October 2022}}
*IMS Medallion Lecture, 2012<ref>[http://bulletin.imstat.org/2011/06/world-class-speakers-for-world-congress/ World-class speakers for World Congress, 10 June 2011] [[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]] Bulletin</ref>
*Inaugural Wolfgang Doeblin Prize in Probability, 2012{{citation needed|date=October 2022}}
*[[Loève Prize]] 2013{{citation needed|date=October 2022}}
*ICM Invited talk, 2014<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://statweb.stanford.edu/~souravc/awards.html|title = Sourav Chatterjee}}</ref>
*[[Infosys Prize]] 2020{{citation needed|date=October 2022}}
*[[Fellow of the Royal Society]] 2023<ref>{{Cite web |title=Sourav Chatterjee |url=https://royalsociety.org/people/sourav-chatterjee-36210/ |access-date=26 May 2023 |website=royalsociety.org}}</ref>
*[[Fellow of the American Academy of Arts and Sciences]] 2024<ref>{{Cite web |title=Sourav Chatterjee |url=https://www.amacad.org/new-members-2024}}</ref>
